User.title: User Profile
User.description: User account info and tenant association on StoreSage

name.description: The visual name of the user

role.description: User's role such as admin or staff

store_id.description: ID of the store/tenant the user belongs to

Tenant.title: Tenant Profile
Tenant.description: Tenant subscription status mapped by user UID

subscriptionExpiresAt.description: ISO date string when the subscription expires

Store.title: Store (Tenant)
Store.description: Tenant store information and subscription status

status_langganan.description: SaaS Subscription status, e.g., active, free, trialing, suspended

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Stock item within a particular store

sku.description: Stock Keeping Unit unique barcode/ID identifier

stock_minimum.description: Threshold where warning displays when stock drops to or below this

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Cash flow transaction record within a particular store

tenantId.description: ID of the store/tenant the transaction belongs to

type.description: Type of cash transaction: income or expense

/tenants/{tenantId}.description: Tenant subscription record mapped by user UID.

/users/{uid}.description: Individual member user profile associating them with a dedicated tenant (store_id).

/stores/{storeId}.description: Isolated store master tenant document containing settings and status.

/stores/{storeId}/products/{productId}.description: Siloed collection of products associated with a single Tenant Store. Secured via user's corresponding store_id match.

/stores/{storeId}/transactions/{transact.description: Siloed collection of sales/expense transactions. Secured via user's corresponding store_id match.
